title: Samsone: A Family of Open Small Audio Language Models for On-Device Inference
abstract: arXiv:2609.21666v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The success of Large Audio Language Models has driven the development of massive multimodal networks exceeding billions of parameters. However, the demand for privacy-preserving, low-latency processing has shifted focus toward Small Audio Language Models (SALMs) capable of on-device execution. In this paper, we introduce Samsone, a family of SALMs designed for edge computing. Our core model, Samsone-134M, establishes a new state-of-the-art for its size class across multiple benchmarks. We further explore the scaling laws of SALMs by introducing Samsone-99M and Samsone-356M. Despite their compact footprint, the Samsone family delivers performance competitive with models orders of magnitude larger. To foster open research and reproducibility, we train Samsone on publicly available data. translated_title: Samsone：面向设备端推理的开源小型音频语言模型家族
translated_abstract: 大型音频语言模型的成功推动了参数规模超过数十亿的庞大多模态网络的发展。然而，对隐私保护和低延迟处理的需求使研究焦点转向了能够在设备端执行的小型音频语言模型（SALMs）。在本文中，我们介绍了Samsone，一个专为边缘计算设计的SALM家族。我们的核心模型Samsone-134M在多个基准测试中为其规模级别树立了新的最先进水平。我们进一步通过引入Samsone-99M和Samsone-356M探索了SALM的缩放定律。尽管模型体积紧凑，Samsone家族的性能可与比其大几个数量级的模型相媲美。为了促进开放研究和可复现性，我们在公开可用的数据上训练Samsone。我们发布了训练代码、模型权重、针对移动设备优化的检查点，并提供了一个开源的Android应用程序来演示实时的设备端推理。
tldr: Samsone是一系列专为设备端推理设计的开源小型音频语言模型，其核心模型Samsone-134M在多个基准测试中达到同规模最先进水平，且性能可媲美比其大几个数量级的模型。
en_tdlr: Samsone is a family of open small audio language models designed for on-device inference, whose core model Samsone-134M sets a new state-of-the-art for its size class while rivaling models orders of magnitude larger.
